name: SPT-CL J0100-5359 (Webb)
blurb: SPT-CL J0100-5359, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: sptclj01005359-webb
story: A massive cluster of galaxies, chosen from thousands of candidates to sample how clusters grew over billions of years. Webb's view helps show how dark matter spreads through the cluster and is stripped from the smaller clumps within it.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ0100-5359 is one of the 182 massive galaxy clusters in Webb survey program 5594
The clusters were picked from Sunyaev-Zel'dovich cluster candidates (SPT, ACT and Planck) and X-ray catalogs
The survey tracks billions of years of cluster growth
Science goals: how infalling galaxies build the bright central galaxy, how dark matter is distributed and tidally stripped from sub-halos, and strong lensing
SPT clusters are found in South Pole Telescope data through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
